text:
riley: Morning team - customer Greenbyte flagged a billing anomaly for May 4th: embeddings bill +1.9M tokens vs expected. No customer-side change. tagging ops+billing.
san: dropping a sample request_key from support ticket: GB-2029-55 at 2029-05-04T04:12Z. Querying embedding_events.
san: quick check shows same kafka_message_key present with two different kafka_offsets (i.e., message reprocessed). snippet: ```sql
SELECT message_key, count(*) FROM embedding_events WHERE message_key = 'GB-2029-55' GROUP BY message_key; -- returns 2 (expected 1)
```
ops-bot: Alert: broker-consumer-restart detected in ingestion-consumer-group at 2029-05-04T04:10Z.
riley: Could consumer restart + bad offset commit cause replays?
san: yep. Consumer crashed, restarted while offsets hadn't been committed; reprocessed ~1.9M embedding events during the 4:10-4:25 window. I can produce a list of duplicated message_keys.
tara: That explains duplicates. We should treat duplicate message_key as idempotent and dedupe in billing, but ingestion currently only dedupes on request_id and vector_hash, not message_key.
ledger-bot: Proposed remediation: 1) add kafka_message_key to dedupe keys (customer_id, message_key, model); 2) run backfill; 3) ledger credit with memo "dedupe-backfill: kafka reprocess (May 4)".
riley: Estimate please. What's token delta?
san: Running aggregation: ```sql
WITH dups AS (
  SELECT customer_id, message_key, count(*) cnt, sum(tokens) toks
  FROM embedding_events
  WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2029-05-04 04:00' AND '2029-05-04 04:30'
  GROUP BY customer_id, message_key
  HAVING count(*) > 1
) SELECT sum((cnt - 1) * (toks / cnt)) as duplicate_tokens FROM dups;
```
-- dry-run result: 1,936,420 duplicate tokens for Greenbyte.
tara: Greenbyte is on enterprise plan rate $0.00015/token, so delta ~ $290.46. Need finance approval and CSV of request_ids for records.
ledger-bot: Backfill job BF-2029-501 created (dry-run completed). Potential ledger impact: -$290.46. Requires manual approval to run adjustments.
riley: Ops, can we patch ingestion to record kafka_message_key and prefer it for dedupe on reprocessed windows?
san: PR opened: `ingest/dedupe-by-kafka-key`. Will deploy canary; quick test shows it catches the duplicate set. Also adding consumer offset commit guard to reduce replays.
ledger-bot: Also recommend adding metric `billing.kafkareplay_dedup_rate` and alert if per-customer dup rate > 0.4% in 1h.
tara: Finance approved the credit amount. Please post ledger entries and notify Greenbyte with a short explanation that their invoice has been adjusted due to an ingestion consumer reprocess. Draft will include backfill job id BF-2029-501 and memo.
riley: Running the backfill now after approval. Dry-run CSV uploaded to ticket.
san: Backfill complete; de-duplicated events and tokens reconciled. Final posted delta: 1,936,420 tokens, $290.46 credit. Uploaded request_id CSV and ledger lines.
ledger-bot: Ledger entries posted. Customer notification queued.
tara: Thanks everyone. Let's add this to postmortem: root cause = consumer offset commit race during restart; fixes = commit guard, kafka_message_key dedupe, monitoring. Also add runbook to pause billing for windows with consumer restarts until dry-run completes.
riley: Agreed. Closing loop and tagging platform reliability to own follow-up. :+1:
